s2.quote: Farikede (South reef or Plateau) Depth: 30m+/ 100ft Top reef: 15m/50ft

highlights.text: Silvertip, grey reef and thresher sharks

s1.quote: RASGE FANNO (East) Dive Type: Easy, OW diver Depth: Top reef: 5 – 7 meters | Mid: 18 – 30 meters | Slopes into the blue Pelagic: Pelagic Threshers

highlights.text: Pelagic thresher sharks; seasonal oceanic mantas

s1.quote: British Loyalty lies on its starboard side at 33m near Gan

s2.quote: The wreck is 134 metres long and lies at a depth of 33 metres, on its port side.

s1.quote: Maa Kandu Channel / Mudakan Manta Point … Hook on to the reef at 20-25m to combat the current … Up to 30 reef mantas have been seen on a single dive here.

highlights.text: Reef mantas, up to 30 on one dive
